"""HOSTILE FIXTURE: lower only in the executor's bounded probe container."""

FRAMEWORK = "jax"
INPUTS = {"inputs/features": ((3,), "float32")}


def init(key):
    return []


def forward(params, x):
    print("HOSTILE_L4_PROBE:memory", flush=True)
    blocks = []
    while True:
        # Fill every page so this consumes charged memory, not only virtual space.
        blocks.append(bytearray(b"x" * (1 << 20)))
